title: 17th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamdu and Salawat) as the sitting begins.
Announcement of the day's agenda (agenda no. AJ/17/1/2026).
Approval of the minutes of four sittings (minutes nos. 11/1/2026 to 14/1/2026).
First reading of the Cyber Security Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hussain Nasih, MP for Medhu Henveiru.
First reading of the Personal Data Protection Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Ali Ibrahim, MP for Henveiru Hulhangu.

Continued debate on a resolution by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed calling for an end to unlawful activities by some political parties against the Constitution and Political Parties Act, and legal action against them.
National Security Services Committee report on the President's request for Majlis approval to amend Schedule 1 of the Narcotic Drugs Act (Law No. 17/2011), under section 4-3(b).
Votes on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The government's Cyber Security Bill and Data Protection Bill were formally introduced, MPs debated a resolution on unlawful political party activity, and a committee reported on changes to the drug law's schedule.
